title: DAAD Scholarship Database
summary: Search funding for international graduates, doctoral candidates and researchers. Eligibility and deadlines are programme-specific; select Bangladesh as your country of application.
deadline_label: Varies by programme — verify each call

title: Scholarships for international applicants
summary: Official index of Canadian government scholarships and exchanges. Some calls are short-term or require an institution to nominate the applicant; check Bangladesh eligibility and current intake.

title: Government of Canada scholarship search
summary: Search the official scholarship database and confirm whether each opportunity is available to international applicants from Bangladesh.

title: EducationUSA financial aid and scholarship search
summary: Search scholarship and financial-aid listings for study in the United States. Deadlines, degree levels and international eligibility vary by institution.

title: Fulbright opportunities by country
summary: The Foreign Student Program is managed by country. Check the Bangladesh-specific announcement, eligible fields and application calendar before preparing an application.

title: Global Futures Scholarships 2027 — Bangladesh
summary: The University of Manchester lists Global Futures awards for international students starting September 2027. For eligible Bangladesh-domiciled taught master’s applicants, the published page states an offer and scholarship application deadline of 25 April 2027. Read the full terms and course exclusions before applying.

title: GREAT Scholarships — Bangladesh
summary: The official Bangladesh page lists participating institutions and their scholarship details. Availability, eligible courses and closing dates differ by university and academic year; confirm that a 2027–28 call is open before applying.

title: Commonwealth Scholarships — UK 2027 notice
summary: Bangladesh UGC published a Commonwealth Scholarships UK 2027 notice in September 2026. Open the notice and its attached advertisement/application form to confirm eligibility, route and the exact closing date; this listing does not assume the call is still open.
deadline_label: Check the UGC notice and attached form immediately

title: Chevening Scholarship 2027–28 — cycle status
summary: The official timeline says the 2027–28 application window opened in August 2026 and closed in October 2026. This is retained as a monitoring link, not advertised as currently open; watch for the next cycle.

title: Australia Awards — Bangladesh intake
summary: The official DFAT page provides Bangladesh-specific country information. The 2027 intake round closed on 30 April 2026; monitor the official page for a future intake announcement rather than treating this round as open.

title: University scholarships for international students
summary: Use the official Study Australia portal to locate providers and then check each university’s international scholarship page for the next available round and Bangladesh eligibility.
